req.title: Deleting all tasks leaves empty table
req.statement: The system shall leave GET /tasks/ returning [] after every task has been deleted.
triggers: deleting all tasks leaves empty table

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-035 requires that after deleting every task, GET /tasks/ returns an empty list []. The test suite covers: (1) positive path — delete all 20 pre-loaded tasks one by one and verify GET /tasks/ returns exactly []; (2) negative path — attempt to delete an already-deleted task and verify HTTP 404; (3) boundary path — delete the last remaining task (boundary between non-empty and empty) and verify the transition to []. Each test uses an in-memory SQLite DB via dependency override so tests are isolated and idempotent. Assertions are exact-value to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.executable:
import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app import models

SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r035_pos.db"
engine = create_engine(SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

TASKS = [
    {"id": i, "title": f"Task {i}", "description": None, "completed": False}
    for i in range(1, 21)
]

db = TestingSessionLocal()
for t in TASKS:
    db.add(models.Task(id=t["id"], title=t["title"], description=t["description"], completed=t["completed"]))
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list():
    for task_id in range(1, 21):
        r = client.delete(f"/tasks/{task_id}")
        assert r.status_code == 204, f"Expected 204 for id={task_id}, got {r.status_code}"
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert r.json() == []

test_delete_all_tasks_leaves_empty_list()
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
app.dependency_overrides.clear()

import pytest
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import Base, get_db
from app import models

SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL = "sqlite:///./test_r035_stc.db"
engine = create_engine(SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URL, connect_args={"check_same_thread": False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

db = TestingSessionLocal()
db.add(models.Task(id=1, title="Task One", description=None, completed=False))
db.add(models.Task(id=2, title="Task Two", description=None, completed=True))
db.add(models.Task(id=3, title="Task Three", description=None, completed=False))
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_partial_delete_does_not_empty_list():
    r1 = client.delete("/tasks/1")
    assert r1.status_code == 204
    r2 = client.delete("/tasks/2")
    assert r2.status_code == 204
    r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert r.status_code == 200
    remaining = r.json()
    assert len(remaining) == 1
    assert remaining[0]["id"] == 3
    assert remaining != []

test_partial_delete_does_not_empty_list()
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
